  - paragraph: Who I am, the proof, and where to start.
- main:
  - region "AI Engineer building agents you can verify.":
    - paragraph: Diego Vieira Gonçalves de Souza
    - heading "AI Engineer building agents you can verify." [level=1]
    - paragraph: "I build AI agents for customer support and prove they work. Below is a real system you can run: press a button, watch each step, then open the code and the test results."
    - paragraph:
      - link "Start the tour →":
        - /url: /projects/supportops/
      - link "Live demo":
        - /url: /projects/supportops/#demo
  - region "SupportOps":
    - paragraph: SupportOps
    - heading "SupportOps" [level=2]:
      - link "SupportOps":
        - /url: /projects/supportops/
    - paragraph: A support platform where AI can draft a refund, but only a second person can approve it.
    - paragraph: "Try to approve your own refund. 16 of 25 features verified; open: a third-party identity provider, model-quality evaluation with human review"
    - paragraph:
      - link "Live demo →":
        - /url: /projects/supportops/#demo
      - link "View project":
        - /url: /projects/supportops/
  - region "Foundation and live evals":
    - paragraph: AI core · 1/3
    - heading "Foundation and live evals" [level=2]:
      - link "Foundation and live evals":
        - /url: /projects/foundation/
    - paragraph: The contracts every project shares, and the evaluation that told me my agent was not ready.
    - paragraph: "The failure is the proof. 3 of 5 features verified; open: a provisional failure awaiting review, a run against local services"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/foundation/
  - region "Multi-agent orchestration":
    - paragraph: AI core · 2/3
    - heading "Multi-agent orchestration" [level=2]:
      - link "Multi-agent orchestration":
        - /url: /projects/agents/
    - paragraph: Multi-agent triage with a bounded loop, compared across frameworks on the same contract.
    - paragraph: "Agents need a stop condition. 7 of 8 features verified; open: a quality comparison between frameworks"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/agents/
  - region "Production AI toolkit":
    - paragraph: AI core · 3/3
    - heading "Production AI toolkit" [level=2]:
      - link "Production AI toolkit":
        - /url: /projects/toolkit/
    - paragraph: The boring safety layer that keeps an agent from hurting production.
    - paragraph: "Retries are a safety decision. 6 of 8 features verified; open: cost, latency and quality against a real model, RAG and refusal against a real model"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/toolkit/
  - region "Agent observability":
    - paragraph: Platform · 1/2
    - heading "Agent observability" [level=2]:
      - link "Agent observability":
        - /url: /projects/observability/
    - paragraph: See what an agent did without storing what users said.
    - paragraph: "Observability without surveillance. 12 of 15 features verified; open: production metrics, service integration of the privacy checks, acceptance in production"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/observability/
  - region "Durable async workflows":
    - paragraph: Platform · 2/2
    - heading "Durable async workflows" [level=2]:
      - link "Durable async workflows":
        - /url: /projects/async/
    - paragraph: Agent work that survives a worker dying mid-task.
    - paragraph: "Kill the worker. The task continues. 12 of 15 features verified; open: model metrics, acceptance in production"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/async/
  - region "This site and its design system":
    - paragraph: Craft · 1/2
    - heading "This site and its design system" [level=2]:
      - link "This site and its design system":
        - /url: /projects/design-system/
    - paragraph: A design system with contrast checked by tests, and a site that refuses unproven numbers.
    - paragraph: "This page has tests too. 19 of 24 features verified; open: a screen-reader pass and an owner review, the human-check start flow, end to end, frame rate on a real phone"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/design-system/
  - region "The engineering harness":
    - paragraph: Craft · 2/2
    - heading "The engineering harness" [level=2]:
      - link "The engineering harness":
        - /url: /projects/harness/
    - paragraph: The engineering system that built all of the above with coding agents.
    - paragraph: "How I direct AI to build. 7 of 8 features verified; open: open verification checklists"
    - paragraph:
      - link "View project →":
        - /url: /projects/harness/
  - region "Terminal":
    - heading "Terminal" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Terminal
    - heading "About me" [level=2]
    - paragraph: 4 years of software engineering, 2+ years with generative AI, 1+ year in production. I build AI agents and integrate Claude and OpenAI models into systems through REST APIs, webhooks and tool use, with Python, RAG on pgvector, LangChain, LangGraph and MCP, on AWS.
    - heading "Contact" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - link "+55 88 99797-4229":
          - /url: tel:+558899797-4229
      - listitem:
        - link "dvsdiegovieira@gmail.com":

      - listitem:

          - /url: /experience/
    - paragraph:
      - link "Message me on WhatsApp":
        - /url: https://wa.me/5588997974229

- main:
  - heading "How I build with AI" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Built with coding agents under an engineering harness: specs before code, gated checks, evals, budget ledgers and saved evidence, following AI engineering best practices. Every number here links to the run that produced it."
  - region "Interactive diagram":
    - paragraph: Press Play, or click any box to see what it does. The pulse follows the current step.
    - group "From intake to a gate":
      - button "Pause"
      - button "Previous" [disabled]
      - button "Next"
      - button "Reset"
    - group "From intake to a gate":
      - button "Intake"
      - button "Spec"
      - button "Plan"
      - button "Execute"
      - button "Verify"
      - button "Gate"
    - status: Step 1/2 Nothing is written before the plan says where.
    - group:
      - text: Text version of this diagram
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - strong: Intake
          - text: Lab. Decisions and a profile before any code.
          - list:
            - listitem: then Spec
        - listitem:
          - strong: Spec
          - text: Lab. A written specification with requirement ids.
          - list:
            - listitem: then Plan
        - listitem:
          - strong: Plan
          - text: Lab. Allowed write paths and forbidden changes are declared.
          - list:
            - listitem: then Execute
        - listitem:
          - strong: Execute
          - text: Lab. Agents write the code inside those paths.
          - list:
            - listitem: then Verify
        - listitem:
          - strong: Verify
          - text: Lab. Commands run, exit codes and output are saved.
          - list:
            - listitem: then Gate
        - listitem:
          - strong: Gate
          - text: Lab. No evidence means the result stays incomplete.
  - term: Evidence before done
  - definition: A result needs a command, an exit code and saved output. Without it, the result is incomplete.
  - term: Numbers only from runs
  - definition: Metrics, cost and benchmarks come from recorded runs. Without a run, PENDING.
  - term: A red test is a signal
  - definition: Fix the root cause. Never delete or weaken the test to make it pass.
  - term: Authorized external effects
  - definition: No deploy, publish, push or spend beyond budget without explicit approval.
  - term: Prompts and tools are code
  - definition: They live in the repository, have contract tests, and every change goes through regression.
  - term: One source of truth
  - definition: Profile, builder state, agent contract and run metrics each have exactly one home.
  - heading "AI assistance statement" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Coding agents wrote most of the code in this portfolio. I wrote the specs, set the write paths and the gates, reviewed every diff and decided what counts as evidence. The agents never decide that something is done.
  - paragraph:

      - /url: https://github.com/DiegoVSouza/ai-engineer-lab

    - heading "TL;DR" [level=2]
    - term: Problem
    - definition: Support automation crosses tenant data, tools, background work and money. A model that can approve its own refund is a liability, so the system has to make that impossible by construction, not by prompt.
    - term: My role
    - definition: I designed and built the API, the retrieval, the approval flow, the accounted live path and the console, with coding agents under a spec-first harness.
    - term: Stack
    - definition: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, MCP, Keycloak, React, TypeScript, Fly.io, Cloudflare Pages
    - term: Result
    - definition: The full gate with Docker services passed on the current version (214 passed, 2 skipped), and the live ledger and key failover tests passed against PostgreSQL 16 (17 passed). One real triage on the live demo stack made 4 calls, 2287 in / 434 out tokens, est. USD 0.000304. That is a single run, not a benchmark.
    - paragraph: "Tickets arrive, a team of agents triages them against tenant-scoped knowledge, and every answer cites its sources. Money is the line the model cannot cross: it proposes, a deterministic gate checks, and a human decides. The requester cannot approve their own refund. Open the console and try to."

    - paragraph:
      - text: "The README of this project, in reading order: problem, decisions, failures, results and what I would do differently."
      - link "Open the README on GitHub":
        - /url: https://github.com/DiegoVSouza/supportops-platform/blob/2c1b0c2ba8200a703066f6ae253139fbe7b84669/README.md
    - region "Decisions":
      - heading "Decisions" [level=3]
      - article:
        - heading "Tenant and role come from the token" [level=3]
        - paragraph: The API reads tenant and role from the signed token. A browser token can carry scopes its user's role must not use, so scopes are narrowed by role on the server.
        - paragraph:
          - 'link "Code: supportops_platform/api/app.py"':
            - /url: https://github.com/DiegoVSouza/supportops-platform/blob/2c1b0c2ba8200a703066f6ae253139fbe7b84669/supportops_platform/api/app.py
        - paragraph:
          - strong: "Rejected:"
          - text: Trusting a tenant id or scope list sent by the client.
      - article:
        - heading "The model proposes; a gate and a person decide" [level=3]
        - paragraph: A refund request goes through a deterministic tool and becomes an approval that a different principal must decide. The amount comes from that tool, not from the model.
        - paragraph:
          - 'link "Code: supportops_platform/service_runtime.py"':
            - /url: https://github.com/DiegoVSouza/supportops-platform/blob/2c1b0c2ba8200a703066f6ae253139fbe7b84669/supportops_platform/service_runtime.py
        - paragraph:
          - strong: "Rejected:"
          - text: Letting model output set the amount or approve.
      - article:
        - heading "Reserve the cost before the call" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Each model call reserves its worst-case cost in a Postgres ledger with one atomic statement that also checks the ceiling. A rate-limit answer moves to the next key and bills nothing; an uncertain call keeps its reservation.
        - paragraph:
          - 'link "Code: supportops_platform/agents/demo_live.py"':
            - /url: https://github.com/DiegoVSouza/supportops-platform/blob/2c1b0c2ba8200a703066f6ae253139fbe7b84669/supportops_platform/agents/demo_live.py
        - paragraph:
          - strong: "Rejected:"
          - text: Adding up spend after the fact.

        - definition: The first accounted path stopped all later work after any failed attempt.
        - term: Cause
        - definition: It was built for one reviewed local operation, where a failure should block until a person looks. A public service cannot work that way.
        - term: What changed
        - definition: The public path releases the reservation when a provider answered with an error, and keeps it only when the outcome is unknown.
      - article:
        - term: What happened
        - definition: A clean clone could not install the project.
        - term: Cause
        - definition: An ignore file excluded every locally built wheel, including the ones the lock file points to.
        - term: What changed
        - definition: The five wheels the lock names are tracked and their hashes checked against the lock.
      - article:
        - term: What happened
        - definition: Triage failed from the console with a generic worker failure.
        - term: Cause
        - definition: The worker runs on the caller's scopes, and the console did not request the scopes its tools need.
        - term: What changed
        - definition: Console scopes now match the agent's scopes, with a note to update both when a tool is added.

routes.ariaSnapshot:
- link "Pular para o conteúdo":

- main:
  - heading "Como eu construo com IA" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Construído com agentes de código sob um harness de engenharia: spec antes de código, gates, evals, ledgers de orçamento e evidência salva, seguindo as melhores práticas de engenharia de AI. Todo número aqui leva à execução que o produziu."
  - region "Diagrama interativo":
    - paragraph: Aperte Play, ou clique em qualquer caixa para ver o que ela faz. O pulso acompanha o passo atual.
    - group "Do intake ao gate":
      - button "Pausar"
      - button "Anterior" [disabled]
      - button "Próximo"
      - button "Reiniciar"
    - group "Do intake ao gate":
      - button "Intake"
      - button "Spec"
      - button "Plano"
      - button "Executar"
      - button "Verificar"
      - button "Gate"
    - status: Passo 1/2 Nada é escrito antes de o plano dizer onde.
    - group:
      - text: Versão em texto deste diagrama
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - strong: Intake
          - text: Lab. Decisões e um perfil antes de qualquer código.
          - list:
            - listitem: depois Spec
        - listitem:
          - strong: Spec
          - text: Lab. Uma especificação escrita com ids de requisito.
          - list:
            - listitem: depois Plano
        - listitem:
          - strong: Plano
          - text: Lab. Caminhos de escrita permitidos e mudanças proibidas são declarados.
          - list:
            - listitem: depois Executar
        - listitem:
          - strong: Executar
          - text: Lab. Agentes escrevem o código dentro desses caminhos.
          - list:
            - listitem: depois Verificar
        - listitem:
          - strong: Verificar
          - text: Lab. Comandos rodam, exit codes e saída são salvos.
          - list:
            - listitem: depois Gate
        - listitem:
          - strong: Gate
          - text: Lab. Sem evidência, o resultado continua incompleto.
  - term: Evidência antes de pronto
  - definition: Um resultado precisa de comando, exit code e saída salva. Sem isso, está incompleto.
  - term: Números só de execuções
  - definition: Métricas, custo e benchmarks vêm de execuções registradas. Sem execução, PENDING.
  - term: Teste vermelho é sinal
  - definition: Corrija a causa raiz. Nunca apague nem enfraqueça o teste para passar.
  - term: Efeitos externos autorizados
  - definition: Sem deploy, publicação, push ou gasto acima do orçamento sem aprovação explícita.
  - term: Prompt e tool são código
  - definition: Vivem no repositório, têm teste de contrato, e toda mudança passa por regressão.
  - term: Uma fonte de verdade
  - definition: Perfil, estado do builder, contrato do agente e métricas de execução têm cada um exatamente um lar.
  - heading "Declaração de uso de IA" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Agentes de código escreveram a maior parte do código deste portfólio. Eu escrevi as specs, defini os caminhos de escrita e os gates, revisei cada diff e decidi o que conta como evidência. Os agentes nunca decidem que algo está pronto.

      - heading "AI Engineer, Grupo Intra de Ensino e Pesquisa a Distância" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Projetei e coloquei em produção um assistente multiagente no WhatsApp com Python, LangGraph, LangChain e MCP (APIs Claude e OpenAI). Um agente classifica intenção e sentimento e roteia para WhatsApp Flows, tool use ou fallback; outro escreve a resposta.
        - listitem: Integrei a APIs REST, webhooks e ao CRM Kommo, automatizando a jornada do aluno em 4 etapas (cadastro, matrícula, provas, certificados) para dezenas de milhares de alunos por mês, com 20% menos suporte manual.

        - listitem: Apliquei evals de prompts, guardrails, mitigação de alucinação, tratamento de falhas e handoff humano, com monitoramento diário no CloudWatch e controle de custo dos modelos.
        - listitem: Liderei arquitetura e backend em Python e n8n, com Docker no AWS ECS, CI/CD no GitHub Actions e TDD; documentei decisões em ADRs e adotei Spec-Driven Development com revisão humana do código gerado por agentes de código.
      - paragraph: "Stack: Python, LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, Claude API, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, AWS ECS, CloudWatch, GitHub Actions, NestJS, Go, n8n"
    - listitem:

      - heading "Software Engineer, Yamaha Motor (via Compass UOL)" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Desenvolvi serviços de back-end com NestJS, TypeScript e Python em microsserviços com Docker, JWT e OAuth, na plataforma de e-commerce da Yamaha, com cache nas APIs.
        - listitem: Construí funcionalidades em Next.js e React e contribuí para o Vibe, plataforma de comunidade em projeto internacional, com Scrum, code reviews e comunicação em inglês.
      - paragraph: "Stack: NestJS, TypeScript, Python, Docker, Next.js, React, Scrum"
    - listitem:

      - list:
        - listitem: Em equipe de 5 na residência em TIC (Softex e MCTI), construí as APIs Flask e FastAPI e a plataforma React para diagnóstico de doenças pulmonares por imagem. A CNN em TensorFlow alcançou 97,27% de acurácia e foi publicada no SBCAS.
      - paragraph: "Stack: Python, FastAPI, Flask, React, TensorFlow, Oracle"

    - term: Meu papel

Uma triagem real na stack do demo live fez 4 calls, 2287 in / 434 out tokens, est. USD 0.000304. É uma única execução, não um benchmark.

        - term: Causa
        - definition: Foi feito para uma operação local revisada, em que uma falha deve bloquear até alguém olhar. Um serviço público não funciona assim.
        - term: O que mudou
        - definition: O caminho público libera a reserva quando o provedor respondeu com erro, e só a mantém quando o resultado é desconhecido.
      - article:
        - term: O que aconteceu
        - definition: Um clone limpo não conseguia instalar o projeto.
        - term: Causa
        - definition: Um arquivo de ignore excluía todas as wheels geradas localmente, inclusive as que o lock aponta.
        - term: O que mudou
        - definition: As cinco wheels que o lock cita estão versionadas e seus hashes conferidos contra o lock.
      - article:

        - definition: O worker roda com os escopos de quem chama, e o console não pedia os escopos que as ferramentas precisam.
        - term: O que mudou
        - definition: Os escopos do console agora seguem os do agente, com um aviso para atualizar os dois ao adicionar uma ferramenta.
